text: Workspaces that take private lending work now get a loan file with no buy or sell side, a one-click thirteen-document underwriting package, and a note of which invoices still come out of the closing.
Compliance checklists can now be written for the buy side, sell side or a dual file, with a different default per client, and every transaction shows how close it is to closing-ready from any tab.
Reports now include a full time report: hours and effective hourly rate per file, per client and per person, over any window you pick.
Tasks now open their own screen where you can write a document, log a call, upload a file, and record what happened, without leaving the task.

Freehold now shows what each file actually costs: time is recorded automatically while a file is open, and Today charts time against fee, your most time-consuming clients, and your most efficient ones.
Scheduled emails sent from your own inbox now show up on the file right away, and replies to them thread back automatically once they go out.
